To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the ALMS1 gene has three transcript variants with different expression levels in Hodgkin lymphoma cell lines.

(i) the Alstrom syndrome gene ALMS1 is expressed in Hodgkin lymphoma cells; (ii) ALMS1 is localized to the centrosome in these cells and (iii) the ALMS1 transcript is alternatively spliced in Hodgkin lymphomas cells

the Alstrom syndrome 1 (ALSM1) gene is expressed in Hodgkin Lymhoma cells with highest expression in the KM-H2 cells, that ALMS1 is localized to the centrosome, and that the expression of the ALMS1 gene is regulated by three alternative splice variants that affect exons two, thirteen, and twenty-three.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the characterization of the ALMS1 transcripts in HL cells.
the characterization of novel ALMS1 transcript variants in HL cells.
the characterization of ALMS1 transcript variants in HL cells and the impact of the identified transcript variants on ALMS1 protein structure.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
ALMS1 is differentially expressed between HL and normal cells and that the ALMS1 gene is subject to alternative splicing.
ALMS1 is expressed in HL cells and is differentially regulated by alternative splicing and alternative polyadenylation.
the expression of ALMS 1 is not essential for cell survival in HL cell lines.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the ALMS1 gene is expressed in HL cells and that the expression is regulated at the transcriptional and posttranscriptional level by alternative splicing and/or alternative polyadenylation.
ALMS1 expression is low but detectable in HL cells.
we have characterized ALMS1 transcripts in Hodgkin lymphoma cell lines and identified three variable regions that affect exons in ALMS1.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ALMS1 transcript variants are expressed in HL cells.
ALMS1 expression is low and highly variable in HL cells.
ALMS1 is expressed in Hodgkin Lymhoma cells and that ALMS1 transcript variants exist in HL cells.
